jobs.description: WHY CFAB?Behind every campaign, every product, and every growth milestone stands a team that takes ownership, moves fast, and delivers results. That is what cfab is all about.What looks like a strong brand from the outside is powered by high performance, fast execution, and people who work with real intensity to drive our growth every day.As a Product & Packaging Compliance Manager (m/f/d) , you will make sure every product we sell in the EU and the US meets all product, packaging and labeling requirements, from fabric and care labels to cartons and polybags. You will turn regulatory text into clear requirements for our suppliers and teams, and release artwork and packaging before production.You will work closely with Buying, Product, our sourcing team, suppliers and external legal and EPR partners. At the same time, you will establish the processes, standards and controls that make compliance work consistently across all our brands and markets.YOUR IMPACT• Monitor, interpret and implement EU and US product, packaging and labeling legislation, including GPSR, the EU Textile Labelling Regulation, EU packaging law (PPWR, national EPR) and US FTC textile, care and country-of-origin labeling rules• Own materials, packaging and labeling compliance for every product, from fabric, cartons and polybags to hangtags, care labels and product labels, including importer and manufacturer identification and traceability• Review and release supplier artwork and packaging proofs before production and before shipment• Establish governance processes, standards and controls so requirements are applied consistently across brands, suppliers and markets• Act as internal counterpart to external legal counsel and EPR/packaging registration partners• Maintain technical documentation and compliance records, including GPSR Responsible Person duties and retention obligations• Manage non-conformities with suppliers, from root cause analysis to corrective actions, and train Buying, Product and the sourcing team on requirementsWHY YOU WOULD BE A GOOD FIT FOR US• Degree or vocational training in Law, Textile or Product Management, Supply Chain Management, Business or a related field, or comparable practical experience in product compliance• Work experience in a similar position, ideally in apparel, textiles or consumer goods sold in the EU and US• Ability to read and apply regulatory text directly, not only checklists, and turn it into clear requirements for suppliers and teams• Hands-on experience with artwork and packaging approval processes• Working knowledge of HS/TARIC classification is a plus• Structured and detail-focused, with a good mix of analytical and operational thinking• Fluent German and English• Willingness to work from our headquarters in Düsseldorf at least 4 days per weekWHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT CFAB• Permanent employment contract• 31 vacation days• Flexible working hours• Apple equipment (MacBook, iPhone)• Employer-paid team lunch three times a week• Monthly tax-free benefits of your choice• Corporate Benefits and discounts• Manicure and barber appointments at the office• Monthly product vouchers• Optional company car after the probation period• Personal birthday voucher• Regular team events and celebrations• Plenty of room for your own ideas, ownership and active contributionWHAT MOTIVATES USAt cfab ambition and speed go hand in hand with high standards for our work. We don’t just want to develop ideas: we want to bring them to life quickly and see what comes of them. For us, it’s not just about good ideas, but above all about the results they produce.Our growth is driven by people who set high standards, drive things forward, and want to grow alongside us. Here you’ll have the space to take on responsibility, develop your skills, and make your own impact visible.READY TO CREATE WHAT’S NEXT?Let’s make it happen.

jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. safety strategies for compounds in development and marketed products.Working within a global, cross-functional environment, you will play a key role in enabling informed development decisions and bringing meaningful therapeutic innovations to patients worldwide.Join us in shaping the future of medicine - apply now!This position can be filled in Ingelheim or BiberachThis position has a hybrid It safeguards business continuity and addresses security and compliance risks while enabling greater standardization, harmonization and centralization across Finance. Alongside new-country rollouts, the program continuously evolves and supports the productive solution used by countries already live on LUCA.Purpose of the roleBased in Düsseldorf, Germany, the SAP Finance Project Manager will lead the delivery of change projects for LUCA countries already operating on the productive SAP S/4HANA Finance solution. Typical assignments include the implementation of new electronic-invoicing mandates, other legal and regulatory requirements, and business-driven changes that affect Finance processes, integrations, data, controls and operational procedures.The role is designed for an experienced SAP Financials professional who has moved into project coordination and delivery management. The Project Manager must understand Finance requirements and SAP solution implications well enough to structure work, challenge plans, connect the correct experts and drive decisions, while remaining accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and stakeholder alignment in a large international SAP landscape.Your responsibilitiesEnd-to-end project delivery- Own the delivery of assigned SAP Finance projects for LUCA live countries from initiation and scoping through design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and closure.- Translate legal, regulatory and business change requests into structured projects with clear objectives, scope boundaries, deliverables, milestones, governance, resource needs and acceptance criteria.- Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering functional design, technical implementation, interfaces, data, testing, cutover, communication, training and operational readiness.- Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions and change control, ensuring that deviations are visible and addressed early.- Prepare concise status reporting, decisions and recommendations for LUCA governance, country stakeholders and management.Regulatory and business change delivery- Coordinate the implementation of country-specific electronic-invoicing mandates and other legal or tax-driven changes, working with Finance local, central, system implementors, and partner-system specialists.- Lead business-change projects that enhance or adapt live SAP Finance processes, ensuring alignment with the LUCA global template and the needs of productive operations.- Ensure requirements are sufficiently clear, approved and traceable, and that legal effective dates and business deadlines are translated into realistic delivery plans.- Coordinate impact assessments across SAP Finance, SAP Ariba where relevant, master data, reporting, authorizations, interfaces and non-SAP partner systems.- Protect productive operations by ensuring controlled releases, appropriate regression testing, cutover planning, support readiness and post-go-live monitoring.Functional and technical coordination- Use prior SAP Financials experience to understand end-to-end process impacts, ask informed questions and facilitate productive alignment between business and technology teams.- Coordinate solution architects, risks are transparent before deployment.- Plan and govern cutover and production deployment activities with clear responsibilities, sequencing, readiness checks, fallback considerations and management communication.- Act as the central project contact for country Finance stakeholders, LUCA teams, METRO Digital, the System Integrator and other delivery partners.- Build trust across cultures and time About AtariAtari is an interactive entertainment company and an iconic gaming industry brand recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Hipster Whale, Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide.Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, in France, Germany, Sweden, and India.About the roleMünster, Germany · Part-timeThe Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator will provide executive, administrative and project coordination support to the CFO. Based in Germany and working closely with the CFO in France, you will help keep financial administration, corporate governance and cross-border operational matters moving to completion.This is a practical coordination role for someone who is organised, persistent and comfortable following up with banks, lawyers, tax advisers, notaries, corporate service providers and internal teams. You will coordinate documents, signatures, banking administration, KYC and AML requests, legal entity changes and board formalities across the Atari Group.You do not need to be an accountant or a technical finance specialist. You do need to be reliable with sensitive information, comfortable with formal processes and willing to chase the right people until an item is complete.What you’ll do- Provide day-to-day executive and administrative support to the CFO, coordinating priorities across Germany, France and the US.- Coordinate the preparation, circulation, approval and execution of corporate documents, board resolutions, powers of attorney and other legal or finance documentation.- Manage signature workflows, monitor outstanding actions and ensure documents are signed, returned and stored on time.- Coordinate banking administration, including account openings and closures, bank mandates, signatory updates and KYC/AML requests.- Maintain accurate corporate records and legal entity documentation, ensuring information is complete, current and easy to retrieve.- Support legal entity shutdowns, entity administration and related projects by coordinating actions across Finance, Legal, tax advisers, banks and external service providers.- Liaise with banks, external legal counsel, tax lawyers, corporate service providers, notaries and local finance teams on administrative and corporate matters.- Coordinate board minutes, governance records, approvals, formalities and other recurring corporate requirements.- Support finance-related administrative work, including gathering information, tracking deadlines, maintaining records and coordinating deliverables.- Act as a project coordinator for cross-functional finance and governance workstreams, keeping owners aligned and following through on open items.- Provide administrative support for certain Luxembourg-related matters and coordinate with the relevant internal and external contacts.- Escalate delays, missing information, unclear ownership or material issues to the CFO or relevant functional lead.Requirements & Qualifications- Professional fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.- Experience in an administrative, executive support, banking, legal operations, paralegal, corporate services or similar coordination role.- Strong organisation and follow-through, with the confidence to chase people, manage deadlines and keep multiple workstreams moving.- Experience handling confidential information and formal documentation with accuracy and discretion.- Comfort working with banks, lawyers, advisers, notaries, corporate service providers or other external stakeholders.- Ability to work independently, prioritise changing requests and operate with flexibility when the CFO and key stakeholders are based in another country.- Good judgement and attention to detail when coordinating governance, KYC/AML, banking and legal entity administration.Nice to have- Professional proficiency in French.- Experience supporting a CFO, finance leader, executive team or European corporate function.- Experience in a bank, financial institution, law office, corporate services provider or multinational business.- Familiarity with KYC/AML processes, bank mandates, signatory administration, powers of attorney, board documentation or legal entity management.- Experience coordinating entity closures, corporate reorganisations, acquisitions or other cross-border projects.- Familiarity with Luxembourg corporate or finance administration.How you’ll workThis role is about making sure important administrative and governance work does not sit unresolved. You will often be coordinating several parties at once, clarifying what is needed, tracking who owns the next step and following up until the document, approval, bank request or entity action is complete.You will work closely with Finance and Legal, but you are not expected to provide accounting or legal advice. Your value will come from being dependable, organised and persistent, and from creating enough structure that the CFO and specialist advisers can make decisions and complete formalities efficiently.The role requires flexibility in working hours to accommodate cross-border coordination with the CFO in France, banks, advisers and teams in other time zones.Why join AtariThis role sits at the centre of an international finance and governance environment. You will work across Germany, France, Luxembourg and other Atari Group locations, helping coordinate the formalities and projects that support the Group’s entities and operations.You will have visibility across Finance, Legal and senior leadership, with the opportunity to build a reliable operating rhythm for corporate administration and cross-border coordination as Atari continues to integrate and develop its international business.EEO StatementAtari is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. Von AI bis 5G, vom autonomen Fahren bis zur Raumfahrt - nahezu jede bahnbrechende Innovation von heute hat ihren FormFactor.Job Description:Field - Service Engineer (m/f/d)who performs installations, troubleshooting and repairs at our customers' sites.In our company, your core responsibilities include:- Supporting our Wafer Probe System product in the EMEA region- Installation & commissioning of probers and accessories, including final acceptance according to test and acceptance regulations- Independent execution of preventive & corrective maintenance at the customer's site in the service area EMEA- Technical training and instruction of customers- Troubleshooting and repair of our probers both as remote / telephone support and at the customer's site- Timely processing and documentation of work orders and service calls according to FormFactor guidelines- Actively collaborate with other FormFactor departments to ensure continuous improvement of products- Regular participation in qualification measures- Adherence to all health and safety requirements both internally and during customer service callsWhat you should bring with you:- Engineer or technician in the field of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, automation technology or similar- At least 2-4 years of experience in a similar field of activity is typically required, ideally in semiconductor industry- Detail-oriented work and strong problem-solving skills- Accuracy, punctuality, good team and interpersonal skills- Good communication skills in German and English both verbally and in writing- Good knowledge of common MS Office applications- Valid driving license and willingness to travel requiredSkills:Deutsche Sprache, Elektromechanik, Englische Sprache, Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Optik, Optische Messtechnik, OptoelektronikEducation & Experience:Minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; jobs.occupation: Procurement Consultant – IT Procurement (m/f/d) (Fachwirt/in - Einkauf/Bachelor Professional in Procurement)
jobs.description: Company DescriptionAbout us:Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!How you will make an impact?As a Procurement Consultant, you will manage strategic procurement activities for IT products and services. You will advise internal stakeholders, lead competitive sourcing processes and negotiate commercially attractive and sustainable agreements.Acting as the interface between our internal teams and external suppliers, you will help translate business and technology requirements into effective sourcing strategies. You will also contribute to supplier performance, category initiatives and the continuous development of our procurement approach.Job DescriptionYour Responsibilities:- Manage procurement activities for IT products and services from initial demand through supplier selection, negotiation and contracting;- Advise and support internal stakeholders in developing the appropriate sourcing and procurement approach;- Prepare, lead and execute RFIs, RFPs and other competitive sourcing processes;- Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers, considering price, quality, risk, flexibility and long-term business value;- Analyze supplier proposals and create transparent commercial evaluations and management recommendations;- Act as a key interface between internal stakeholders, Legal, Finance, Security and external suppliers;- Support contract development and ensure that commercial requirements, responsibilities and deliverables are clearly defined;- Manage supplier relationships and contribute to structured governance, performance reviews and continuous improvement;- Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership, consolidate demand and optimise the supplier portfolio;- Contribute to category strategies, market analyses and procurement initiatives;- Support procurement-related projects and continuously improve sourcing processes, templates and ways of working;- Manage several procurement activities in parallel while ensuring quality, transparency and timely delivery.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Several years of professional experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management or a comparable commercial role;- Solid understanding of IT procurement, including software, cloud, professional services, managed services or other IT-related categories;- Experience in leading sourcing processes and commercial negotiations with national and international suppliers;- Good understanding of commercial and contractual models, such as fixed-price, time-and-materials, subscription, managed-service and outcome-based arrangements;- Ability to analyse complex offers and translate commercial information into clear recommendations;- Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build credibility across different functions and seniority levels;- Confidence in challenging requirements and supplier proposals constructively;- A proactive, structured and results-oriented working style;- Ability to work independently, prioritise a varied workload and meet agreed deadlines;- Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills;- A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to the further development of the procurement organisation;- Fluent English, both written and spoken. German would be an advantage.What success looks like in this role:- Internal stakeholders receive pragmatic, reliable and commercially sound procurement advice;- Sourcing activities are executed transparently, efficiently and in line with business requirements;- Negotiations deliver measurable commercial value while maintaining sustainable supplier relationships;- Commercial, contractual and supplier risks are identified early and addressed appropriately;- Procurement is recognized as a strategic partner that enables business outcomes rather than only processing transactions.Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.- People development: when you grow so do we!We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Procurement Consultant - PRC3 (Md7).
